name: Advanced Example
description: A multi-script starter demonstrating Chataigne lifecycle, module state, and OSC routing.

Example Enabled.description: Allow the example OSC route to update module state.

Device label.description: Included in the status message published by the OSC handler.

Log OSC details.description: Log details for OSC messages handled by the example route.

Status.description: A short status published by the example OSC route.

Last OSC address.description: The last matching OSC address handled by this module.

Message count.description: Number of matching OSC messages handled since module load.
